title: Steamed Broccoli with Lemon for Baby-Led Weaning
summary: Looking for easy ways to serve broccoli to your baby? I’ve got you!
steps: In a medium saucepan, bring 2" of water to a boil over high heat. Add a steamer basket with the broccoli florets. Cover and cook for 8-10 minutes or until tender when pricked with a fork.
Remove from heat, and let cool.
Squeeze the lemon juice on the broccoli and toss.
